name: 温润乳化一步卸净卸妆膏款
description: 水感乳化快卸彩妆，清爽不油腻，眼唇亦可使用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with flat cherry-pink #F7DFE4 fields and one deep-berry #6B3242 closing field
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key, soft contact shadows, one rosy rim accent on the closing shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale-rose board #F3D9DE and warm ivory counter #F4EAE0
styleLock.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif, short headline bands only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in a single berry accent
styleLock.presentationRules: jar always upright at a stable slight three-quarter hero angle and stable scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft rose cleansing-balm beauty visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cherry-blossom pink #F7DFE4, berry-rose accent #C4547E and deep berry text #4E2733; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif with short headline bands only; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end beauty photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright jar presentation at a stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on frontal eye-level view, jar centered and upright, lid leaning beside it
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on frontal eye-level view, the jar centered and upright with its lid resting beside it, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the jar. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达一罐乳化快卸的核心利益，承接主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight three-quarter angle, jar left of center, a small balm scoop beside it
shots.lighting: gentle front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one small scoop of balm texture beside the jar
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for headline copy
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带承载 「{selling_point_1}」 主标题
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The jar at a slight three-quarter angle on the left, with a small scoop of the balm texture beside it seen in close-up. Flat cherry-blossom pink background #F7DFE4, gentle front-left key light, soft contact shadow. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space on the right 40% for copy, a short headline band reading 「{selling_point_1}」. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented percentages or efficacy data, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大彩妆残留与毛孔负担的痛点，引出卸妆膏的解决位
shots.camera: matched two-panel framing, straight-on at counter level, identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel dim and flat, right panel bright and fresh, both soft from the camera side
shots.background: left panel deep berry #6B3242, right panel soft cherry pink #F7DFE4
shots.props: a pale cotton pad, water droplets
shots.textZone: 双panel顶部横带承载 「{callout_1}」 痛点短句
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and light. Left panel: a cotton pad smeared with stubborn foundation and eyeliner residue under dim flat light, conveying half-removed makeup. Right panel: {product} standing beside a clean pad with clear water droplets, bright and fresh. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel background deep berry #6B3242, right panel soft cherry pink #F7DFE4. The subject occupies 50-60% per panel, no extra whitespace. A top band across both panels reads 「{callout_1}」. shots.lighting: soft warm evening window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow

shots.lighting: skimming light from the right revealing the silky melting texture

shots.props: water droplets beading on the right panel

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 首屏为粉色膏罐开盖图配玫瑰植物插画与四枚圆标卖点（温和亲肤/温和卸妆/清爽不油/眼唇可用）；P2 产品介绍段加「拒绝黄·堵·毒」卡通菌痛点屏；P3 四联使用利益图含真人面部；P4 四种植物提取物卡片与环绕功能标注；P5 环绕卖点加手背六步卸妆实拍（编号1-6）；P6 三步使用方法插画；P7 白底产品图与纸盒全家福；P8 罐底喷码与包装盒加会员二维码贴片。品类判定依据：图为膏罐卸妆产品，品名区域明确写「卸妆膏」，使用步骤为面部/眼部/唇部涂抹-加水乳化-清水洗净，功效区四项均为卸妆/洁面方向，taxonomy 将「卸妆」列于「美妆彩妆」之下，故判为 美妆彩妆/卸妆，而非护肤个护/面部护理。已剥离：原品牌名与花体英文字标、系列名、包装盒印刷美术、真人模特面部与身份、原文案原句、净含量与容量数值、罐底批号喷码、会员角标与二维码、原平台店铺字样；产品一律以 {product} 占位，数值与断言一律改 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白占位。与库内近似模版差异：①色板全新——樱粉 #F7DFE4、莓果玫 #C4547E、深莓紫 #4E2733、淡玫板 #F3D9DE、暖象牙台面 #F4EAE0 均未在库内任何套图出现（#FFFFFF 为通用白底基色），库内美妆彩妆四套分别用酒红/玫瑰陶土/紫罗兰灰/鼠尾草体系，护肤个护段高频米色亦全部避开；②背景体系不同——白-樱粉平场-深莓暗底收口三段式，不用库内已有的 riser 色块、笔触色 swipe、orbit 圆环、magnifier 视窗等元件；③道具不同——空白磨砂小刮板、素面纸盒、化妆棉与水珠组合为库内未见；④机位混排不同——front/three-quarter/high 45 度俯视/side profile macro/overhead flat lay 交替，深莓暗底收口为库内美妆彩妆各套均无；⑤角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>COMPARISON>TRUST>CTA 与库内美妆彩妆四套的序列（均以 HERO>PAIN_POINT>COMPARISON 开头或含三连 DETAIL）不同。
